blocks.text: Greesum 4 Pieces Patio Furniture Sets Feature: Easy to assemble and move Modern design for your modern life Soft cushions can make you feel comfortable when you sit on it Excellent manufacture technology make the chairs looks very smooth and fashion Anti rust and anti-corrosion treatment make the chair has longer service life Rattan wicker has outstanding sturdy to stand your weight and the material looks like very smooth It can be widely used in differnt scenarios such as can use it to have a nice chat with your firends in your beautiful garden Specification: Color: Brown and Beige Material: Rattan wicker and glass Dimension of table: 28.1" x 16.1" x 15.4" Dimension of love seat: 35" x 20.7" x 25" Dimension of single seat: 18.1" x 18.1" x 34.1" Package Dimensions: 37.5"(L) x 11.3"(W) x 25.8"(H) Weight:48.51lbs Package includes: A tool kit Beige cushions A love seat Two single chairs A glass coffee table A manual of installation and usage Notice: There may be some differences between the photos and products in terms of color due to the influence of the lighting during the process of shooting

items: Modern and comfortable rattan wicker construction with soft cushions for a stylish and relaxing outdoor experience
Versatile 4 piece set includes loveseat, 2 chairs and glass top coffee table for lounging and entertaining
Durable and weather resistant materials hold up to the elements; anti-rust and anti-corrosion treatment
Easy assembly with included tools and manual; wipe clean with damp cloth for simple maintenance
Perfect for backyard, patio, poolside, balcony, porch or garden use
